definition: Literal consumer names, repository URLs, paths and named origin pins. Bare mathematical uses of the word gate are not repository dependencies. Declared references/inputs are reviewed exact occurrences, not removal debt; an unlisted occurrence still refuses. This finite lexical vocabulary does not decide the meaning of arbitrary new words. Common English words are matched only in declared source contexts or subject paths. Text without NUL must decode as UTF-8. Historical selectors retain their retirement limits when this policy is extended.
opaque_digests: SHA-1 and SHA-256 fields in an otherwise unchanged line are opaque; input contracts check their bytes.
